export_controls.text: As reports continue to come to light regarding Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, and MegaSpeed, there are clear national security concerns that need to be addressed immediately [...] We need to know the full extent to which our national security has been put at risk. This situation is a prime example of why Congress must immediately pass the AI OVERWATCH Act, Chip Security Act, MATCH Act, and Remote Access Security Act in the NDAA.

This is a prudent step toward understanding the capabilities, opportunities, and risks of frontier AI models. I commend @POTUS for recognizing the critical role AI plays in national security, economics, and critical infrastructure. To that end, we are pleased the @NSAGov has been tasked to play a leading role in collaborating with frontier labs, evaluating models, and promoting the cybersecurity of our nation. 

It’s my hope that @POTUS will continue driving the executive branch towards smart AI policies that maintain the U.S. advantage over China. Going forward, we must take a careful look at China’s access to American compute and partner semiconductor manufacturing equipment and consider opportunities to cut down on China’s illicit access to this technology.
